cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.

mechanism: A uses bridal-photography corrections to send B through a restricted door first, presenting the delay in A own entry as professional handling of the dress.
confusable: S02 might bargain for compliance; S03 must make corrective expertise the reason the other person goes first.
comparison: Grape alternative uses quality inspection and sample method rather than photographic positioning.
seedUse: Rooftop bride/train seed supplies the rule and first-entry pressure; keep the roles but replace generic forgiveness with actual posing/space corrections.
